why: The crescent turns 90 degrees anticlockwise each time: opening down, right, up, left. The small symbol inside the hollow of each figure is the one that was on the crescent in the figure before (circle in A, then circle in hollow of B). So in C the plus (on the crescent in B) goes into the hollow, and the square (in the hollow of D) must be on the crescent: option 2. Option 4 has the plus correct but a circle on the crescent.
trick: When two small symbols are inside a moving shape, check if one symbol passes to the other place in the next figure.
note: Whole row A, B, ?, D drawn as one SVG because D comes after the ?.
